description: Na₅Zr₄Si₃(PO₈)₃ crystallizes in the trigonal R32 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.49 Å) and three longer (2.77 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.51-2.81 Å. There are two inequivalent Zr sites. In the first Zr site, Zr is bonded to six O atoms to form ZrO₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra and corners with three equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. All Zr-O bond lengths are 2.10 Å. In the second Zr site, Zr is bonded to six O atoms to form ZrO₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra and corners with three equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.04 Å) and three longer (2.20 Å) Zr-O bond lengths. Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four ZrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 30-32°. There are two shorter (1.63 Å) and two longer (1.64 Å) Si-O bond lengths. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four ZrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 25-39°. There are two shorter (1.54 Å) and two longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zr, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zr, and one P atom.
